title: Establish an information security management system
summary: When the company needs an organization-wide ISMS and may seek ISO IEC 27001 certification. An owned ISMS evidence register with reviewed risks, operating controls and a recorded assurance or certification decision.
outcomes: An owned ISMS evidence register with reviewed risks, operating controls and a recorded assurance or certification decision.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When the company needs an organization-wide ISMS and may seek ISO IEC 27001 certification.

parts.title: Document the intended management-system scope
parts.guidance: List organizational boundaries, services, information assets, dependencies and interested parties. Distinguish a proposed certification scope from a claim that the whole business is certified.

execution.rationale: Prepare and reconcile local evidence; external action is separately approved.

parts.title: Approve the applicable framework and risk approach
parts.guidance: A competent security owner reviews the current standard and applicable obligations. Assign authority and resources; this overview guide does not substitute for the full normative requirements or specialist interpretation.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

approval.scope: Approve the applicable framework and risk approach

parts.title: Prepare the risk and control evidence register
parts.guidance: Document identified risks, proposed treatments, control owners and supporting evidence locations. Identify gaps without claiming a written policy demonstrates an operating control.

execution.rationale: Prepare and reconcile local evidence; external action is separately approved.

parts.title: Implement and operate the approved controls
parts.guidance: Accountable control owners perform the approved activities and retain operating evidence. Training, security decisions and production changes remain human work under the relevant approval policies.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

approval.scope: Implement and operate the approved controls

parts.title: Arrange independent review and management evaluation
parts.guidance: Competent reviewers assess the implemented system and management evaluates findings and corrective actions. Keep internal review, external certification and customer assurances distinct.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

approval.scope: Arrange independent review and management evaluation

parts.title: Approve assurance claims and the next review
parts.guidance: The owner checks the evidence and any actual certificate scope before approving external claims. Record unresolved actions, review dates and who can authorize engagement with a certification body.

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

approval.scope: Approve assurance claims and the next review

verify.how: An owned ISMS evidence register with reviewed risks, operating controls and a recorded assurance or certification decision.

notes.text: Operational draft. Source checked on 2026-10-30. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance, certification or completed execution is claimed. The source context is international standard overview; full normative standard not reviewed. Resolve applicable law and expert review before external action.
